managers.name: ConfigManager
directives: The generic type parameters on get_json[T] and get_section[T] MUST be preserved by all adapter implementations for mypy strict mode.
When adding a new config key, update CoreSettings AND ensure both adapters handle the new key correctly.

raises.when: key missing and no default, or value not numeric
key missing and no default, or value not boolean

managers.name: LoggerManager
directives: LoggerManager methods are SYNC only — structlog is sync, no async log methods are needed.
When adding a new log level, update both the Protocol and all adapter implementations.

managers.name: SecretManager
directives: All secret adapters MUST mask secrets in __repr__ and logs. NEVER add a method that returns raw secrets without masking warnings.
When adding a new method, update all adapter implementations AND ensure SecretValue.__repr__ masking covers any new return paths.

managers.name: ErrorHandlingManager
directives: handle_errors is a synchronous decorator factory. It MUST be applied BEFORE any framework-level middleware that catches exceptions.
When adding a new error taxonomy member, update both ErrorClassification enum AND classify() implementation.
The decorator MUST use @functools.wraps to preserve function metadata. It MUST NEVER swallow errors.

managers.name: ObservabilityManager
directives: ObservabilityManager methods are SYNC except flush(). NEVER throw on telemetry failure — degrade gracefully.
When adding a new metric type, update both the Protocol and all adapter implementations.

returns.notes: span object usable as context manager
hex string; empty string if no trace active

managers.name: AuthManager
directives: All validate_token() methods MUST be async — token validation may involve network I/O (JWKS refresh). NEVER cache validation results indefinitely.
When adding a new validation check, update all adapter implementations AND TokenClaims model.

raises.when: token expired, invalid signature, wrong issuer/audience, or not yet valid

managers.name: CacheManager
directives: get_or_set() MUST implement XFetch stampede mitigation. The factory callable MUST be async-compatible for I/O-bound value generation.
All methods are synchronous. get_or_set() factory may be sync or async; sync factories are called directly, async factories must be managed by the caller (this Protocol does NOT mandate asyncio).

managers.name: DatabaseManager
directives: GenericRepository[T] is a Protocol with TypeVar T — adapter implementations MUST preserve the generic type for mypy strict mode.
All repository methods are async because they may involve network I/O (database queries). In-memory adapter simulates this with synchronous operations wrapped in coroutines.

managers.name: FileStorageManager
directives: When implementing a new adapter, ensure upload() accepts bytes (not str) for data to avoid encoding ambiguity.

managers.name: TaskQueueManager
directives: Ack/nack MUST be idempotent — calling ack on an already-acked job is a no-op. DLQ jobs require manual inspection and reprocessing.

returns.notes: None for unknown IDs; never raises

managers.name: ExternalAPIManager
directives: Circuit breaker is per-host — hosts are extracted from URL. get_circuit_state() is synchronous (reads cached state, no I/O).

managers.name: FeatureFlagManager
directives: is_enabled() MUST return False for unknown flags — never throw. get_flag_value() returns default on cache miss. refresh() is async for Unleash polling but may be sync for memory adapters.

managers.name: DependencyManager
directives: module_path must come from a registry allowlisted; never from direct user input.

managers.name: DynamicPromptingManager
directives: Condition matching is dict-based for MVP — CEL is future.

managers.name: AlertManager
directives: Dict-based condition matching for MVP. CEL integration is planned for a future release.

managers.name: RateLimiterManager
directives: Use is_allowed before any rate-limited operation. Bucket keys are arbitrary strings.

managers.name: I18nManager
directives: NEVER throw on missing translation — return [missing: key] as a visible fallback so developers can spot untranslated strings.
When adding a new locale, update the YAML file AND ensure both adapters handle the new locale correctly.

returns.notes: [missing: key] for missing keys; NEVER raises

managers.name: PermissionManager
directives: Always ask PermissionManager before accessing protected resources. Treat human users, AI agents, and teams uniformly as principals with a type attribute. NEVER inherit all user permissions to agents automatically.

raises.when: invalid principal_type or required fields empty
invalid ttl_seconds or required fields empty

managers.name: LicenceManager
directives: Use LicenceManager to determine which features exist for a tenant. This manager validates cryptographically signed licence documents and exposes feature availability as simple flags. It does NOT decide who can use features.
Use LicenceManager to determine which features exist for a tenant. It does NOT decide who can use features — that is the PermissionManager's responsibility.

returns.notes: None if expired past grace period or revoked

managers.name: UpdateManager
directives: Use UpdateManager to discover and apply desktop app updates. Always verify signatures and hashes before installing. Never install unverified artifacts.
Always verify signatures and hashes before installing. Never install unverified artifacts. Use rollback() to recover from failed updates.

raises.when: SHA-256 hash or Ed25519 signature does not match
